tickets.title: Request estate document package
tickets.text:
Subject: Estate planning document request

Hello Nolan Wrenpuddle,

To help keep the financial plan and account records aligned with the current estate plan, please send copies of any available documents listed below:

- Will
- Revocable trust or other trust agreements
- Trust amendments or restatements
- Durable power of attorney
- Health care directive or medical power of attorney
- Beneficiary designation confirmations
- Letters of instruction or executor/trustee contact details
- Any recent attorney summary letter

If another professional should provide these directly, please share the professional’s name, firm, email, and phone number: [________________].

Preferred secure delivery method: [secure portal / encrypted email / mail / other: ________]
Documents already on file: 2014 trust and will
Documents still needed: any later restatement, trustee acceptance language, durable power of attorney, health care directive, attorney summary letter

Thank you,
Mira Quillwhistle

Obtain the requested estate documents from Nolan Wrenpuddle by 2026-02-19 to complete the estate review.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain the current estate document package by 2026-02-19.

tickets.title: Resolve IRA beneficiary inconsistency
tickets.text: Review the beneficiary designations for Nolan Wrenpuddle’s traditional IRA and Roth IRA to resolve the inconsistency where the Roth IRA still lists the 2014 revocable trust as the sole beneficiary, while the traditional IRA lists his children. Ensure alignment with Nolan’s intent by 2026-02-26.
tickets.evidence: Further follow-up is needed by 2026-02-26 on the IRA beneficiary inconsistency, because Nolan expected both retirement accounts to pass directly to his children unless there was a specific reason to keep the trust on one account.

tickets.title: Obtain successor trustee authority evidence
tickets.text: Obtain documentation confirming the successor trustee sequence and authority for Nolan Wrenpuddle’s revocable trust, including evidence that Carla remains the primary successor, Priya Nettlewhisk’s acceptance, and any additional trustee designations, to support the estate review and future trust account administration. Complete this by 2026-03-05.
